ops.text: Ask what workaround they mentioned and why they didn't return to it live
ops.rationale: They lost the follow-up thread during the call and only recovered it from Otter afterward.

ops.text: In-the-moment follow-up support during live interviews
ops.rationale: Pain is specific to losing threads while the conversation is still happening.
Post-call synthesis takes 45–60 minutes and rebuilds what was missed live.

ops.text: Chat-style AI output may feel like distraction during camera-on calls
ops.rationale: Granola felt like another chat window dumping text while trying to stay present.

ops.text: How this differs from summary-after tools like Teams Copilot
ops.rationale: They contrasted in-the-moment help with post-call summaries.

ops.text: Stable spatial layout as a habit-forming affordance
ops.rationale: They valued knowing where to look instead of hunting for the latest AI paragraph.

ops.text: Suggestion churn and scroll-jank could cause them to ignore the product
ops.rationale: Repeated bullets and wrong-time scrolling were explicit turn-off triggers.

ops.text: Confirm dedupe expectations: discarded items stay gone unless new evidence appears
ops.rationale: They expect discard to be conversation-scoped, not cosmetic.

ops.text: Repeated near-duplicate suggestions are worse than silence
ops.rationale: Four pricing prompts from one mention of budget would kill trust.

ops.text: Custom modes and card templates per research study
ops.rationale: They want jobs-to-be-done and unmet needs without rebuilding the whole UI.

ops.text: Ask which card types are non-negotiable vs nice-to-have per call type
ops.rationale: Follow-up questions and customer needs were called non-negotiable.

ops.text: Rationale text and keyboard shortcuts for pin/discard during live calls
ops.rationale: Rationale builds trust; they cannot mouse around during interviews.

ops.text: Privacy and cloud-processing clarity is deal-breaker territory
ops.rationale: Enterprise participants ask where audio goes; real-time AI implies cloud processing.

ops.text: Validate priority: low-noise follow-up cards over novel features
ops.rationale: They want fewer missed threads in the 45 minutes that matter.

ops.text: Session export that respects pins versus discards
ops.rationale: Second priority after reliable follow-up question cards.
